title: [BD] 方块耐久 Block-Durability
description: Make TaCZ guns truly destructive — no more binary "can hit / can't hit". Every bullet chips away at a block's HP, complete with crack progression effects for a deeply satisfying destruction feel.
body:
中文见[GitHub](https://github.com/zhuimeng1233/block-durability)

# Block Durability

Give Minecraft blocks durability values — shoot them enough and they break!

## Dependencies

- **NeoForge** 1.21.1
- **[TaCZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/tacz-1.21.1)** (Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero, NeoForge port) ≥ 1.1.6 — optional; the mod loads without errors when TaCZ is absent but will have no effect.

## Features

- **Whitelist-based**: only blocks listed in the config can be damaged by bullets
- **HP = Hardness × Multiplier**: block HP is derived from vanilla hardness, with manual overrides available
- **Crack progression**: damaged blocks display destruction crack stages (like player mining)
- **Particles & Sound**: block break particles and hit sounds on impact
- **Tag matching**: supports block tags (`tag:minecraft:planks`), automatically compatible with blocks from other mods

## Default Breakable Blocks

| Category | Tag |
|---|---|
| Glass blocks | `tag:c:glass_blocks` |
| Glass panes | `tag:c:glass_panes` |
| Planks | `tag:minecraft:planks` |
| Logs | `tag:minecraft:logs` |
| Wooden doors | `tag:minecraft:wooden_doors` |
| Wooden trapdoors | `tag:minecraft:wooden_trapdoors` |
| Wooden stairs | `tag:minecraft:wooden_stairs` |
| Wooden slabs | `tag:minecraft:wooden_slabs` |
| Wooden buttons | `tag:minecraft:wooden_buttons` |
| Wooden pressure plates | `tag:minecraft:wooden_pressure_plates` |
| Signs | `tag:minecraft:standing_signs`, etc. |

## Configuration

The config file is auto-generated at `config/blockdurability-common.toml`:

```toml
[general]
    enabled = true
    damagePerHit = 1.0            # Fixed damage per bullet hit
    useBulletDamage = false       # Use bullet entity damage instead

[whitelist]
    blockWhitelist = [
        "tag:c:glass_blocks",
        "tag:minecraft:planks",
        # ... supports tag: prefix and name wildcards
    ]

[hp_calculation]
    hardnessMultiplier = 1.5      # HP = max(minHP, hardness × multiplier)
    minBlockHP = 1.0
    blockHPOverrides = []         # Format: "minecraft:glass=2"

[effects]
    spawnBreakParticles = true
    playBreakSound = true
    dropItems = false
